bug_semantics: When memoryLimit is enabled, replace charges memoryLimit.use() with input lengths and then returns str.split(pattern).join(replacement), whose size is occurrence-count times replacement length. An attacker-authored template can therefore allocate far more than the configured cap (quadratic amplification, CWE-400). memoryLimit defaults to Infinity, so only deployments that set a finite cap are affected. GHSA-mmg9-6m6j-jqqx remains published; CVE-2026-34166 is PUBLISHED (not withdrawn/rejected).
flaw_origin: e443068cb9281883ff0fe9f755a15f52ada4e7e2 (feat: DoS prevention, #250) first added Limiter and wired replace to this.context.memoryLimit.use(str.length) while still returning split().join(). Parent fad00aa14e8beac0514ec4196944b33276f1ff2c has replace as stringify(v).split(stringify(pattern)).join(replacement) with no limiter and no src/util/limiter.ts. Later 94440a065333c78dee461af0049dd712c35f9e45 only widened the charge to str.length+pattern.length+replacement.length (the formula the advisory quotes) without charging produced output; that is incomplete tightening, not first-write.
